notes.title: V1.003 Mainly focuses on bugfixes
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I'm excited to announce the latest update for my game, version 1.003. This update includes a number of bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements based on your feedback. Here are the details:

Bugfixes v1.003:

Fixed an issue where achievements were not granting rewards. Unfortunately, if you have already unlocked the affected achievements, you will not receive the rewards. I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

Increased the number of gems players receive and made unlocking rewards a bit easier.

Made levels a bit easier and slowed down enemies.

Increased the fire rate of the Mortar.

Buffed the Dark Elf and Blades Skill.

Fixed an issue where Penetrating Shot was not showing up in some cases.

Corrected spelling mistakes throughout the game.

Fixed an issue where the Valhallas Axe achievement was not tracking.

I hope these changes improve your experience with the game. As a solo developer, I greatly appreciate all of your support and feedback. Please let me know if you encounter any issues or have any suggestions for future updates.

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Patch v0.700 Is Live!
notes.content:
Dear players,

I'm thrilled to announce that the latest update for my game is now live on Steam! As a solo developer, I've been working tirelessly to address issues and make improvements based on your feedback. Here are the changes you can expect to see in version 0.700, released on February 19th, 2023:

Added More Damage upgrade modules: I've added new upgrade modules to give you even more power to take on the enemy hordes.

Fixed some of the Steam achievements: I've addressed some issues with the Steam achievements to ensure they're unlocking correctly.

Added more enemy models: I've added new enemy models to keep the combat fresh and exciting.

Added charger enemy type: A new type of enemy has been added to the game, which is sure to pose a challenge to even the most experienced players.

Changed some of the loading screens graphic: I've updated some of the loading screens to make them more visually appealing.

Added 2 more of "The Caves": I've expanded the game's content by adding two more levels to "The Caves" section.

I hope that these changes will enhance your gameplay experience and make for even more thrilling battles in my game. Your support and feedback have been invaluable, and I look forward to bringing you more updates in the future.

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I hope this update finds you well. I wanted to give you all a detailed update on the progress of my game development. As a solo developer, I have been working tirelessly to ensure that the game is not only fun to play, but also visually stunning and exciting.

I am excited to announce that the game is coming along nicely and is shaping up to be a solid and enjoyable experience. I have been focusing on fine-tuning the gameplay mechanics, improving the graphics and overall user interface, and ensuring that the game runs smoothly. I have also been working on adding new features and content to the game, which I believe will make it stand out from others in the same genre.

While there is still a lot of work to be done, I am confident that I will be able to release the game on time. I understand the importance of not overhyping the game, but I can assure you that it's shaping up to be a great experience that I am confident you will enjoy.

I also want to take a moment to thank all of you for your continued support and patience as I work to bring this game to life. Your feedback and suggestions have been invaluable in helping me make the game the best it can be.

I will keep you all updated with more details as the development progresses. I can't wait for you all to be able to play it and form your own opinion.

Thanks,
SuperBlast Dev :)

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
In the past couple of months, we have been working hard to perfect the look and feel of Rune Break,
for this, we made an overhaul to the UI to make it more understandable and changed some of the skills and features, we Added a secondary skill to each character. You will now be able to Dash/Teleport a short distance while in a tight situation, Also we've added new enemy types and changed the landscape for the first level.
Also, we've updated the In-Game Screenshots to reflect the Game in its current state better.
We would love to hear what you think about the new changes in the comments :)
